title: Sean Payton announces that offensive coordinator Davis Webb will call plays

sources.title: Sean Payton announces that offensive coordinator Davis Webb will call plays
sources.description: Denver Broncos head coach Sean Payton met with the media today at the NFL Scouting Combine and dropped a bit of a bombshell. He confirmed to reporters that offensive coordinator Davis Webb will indeed call plays for the Denver Broncos this upcoming season.
